statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of unexplained syncope and near-syncope
The condition is coded as R55
The patient has a documented personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction
The patient has a documented personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction coded as Z86.73
There is concern for intermittent arrhythmia
Prolonged mobile cardiac telemetry was necessary to correlate the patient's symptoms with potential cardiac rhythm disturbances
The clinical indication note supports that this monitoring was medically necessary
The claim was denied with reason code CO-197
The denial was based on required precertification or prior authorization not being obtained before services were rendered
